# PaceBowl Pet Nutrition (https://pacebowl.com)

> PaceBowl provides free, veterinary-standard dog and cat feeding, BARF/PMR raw diet, 7-day kibble transition, and puppy adult weight calculators based on WSAVA and NRC formulas, with instant printable A4 fridge feeding charts.

## Machine-Readable Resources
- [Agent Skills Index](https://pacebowl.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Structured tool schemas for AI search agents
- [Full LLM Documentation](https://pacebowl.com/llms-full.txt): Complete veterinary formulas and reference tables
- [XML Sitemap](https://pacebowl.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical index of all PaceBowl pet nutrition calculators
- [Crawler Policy](https://pacebowl.com/robots.txt): AI crawler allowlist (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot)
- [Web App Manifest](https://pacebowl.com/site.webmanifest): Progressive web app metadata for PaceBowl

## Core Tools & Direct Landing Pages
- [Dog Calorie & Feeding Calculator](https://pacebowl.com/tools/dog-calorie-feeding-calculator/): WSAVA RER/DER daily kcal, grams, oz, and cups per meal calculator
- [BARF & PMR Raw Dog Food Calculator](https://pacebowl.com/tools/barf-raw-dog-food-calculator/): 70/10/5/5/7/2/1 BARF and 80/10/10 PMR daily grams & 7–30 day freezer batch prep planner
- [7-Day Dog Food Transition Calculator](https://pacebowl.com/tools/dog-food-transition-calculator/): Calorie-matched 7/10/14-day old vs. new kibble mixing chart
- [Cat Calorie & Wet/Dry Food Calculator](https://pacebowl.com/tools/cat-calorie-feeding-calculator/): Indoor cat mixed wet can + dry kibble gram calculator
- [Puppy Adult Weight Calculator](https://pacebowl.com/tools/puppy-adult-weight-calculator/): Breed-size growth curve predictor from 6 to 52 weeks

## Key Differentiators & Veterinary Standards
- **WSAVA RER Formula**: `RER = 70 * (weight_kg ^ 0.75)` with life-stage multipliers from 0.8x (feline weight loss) to 3.0x (young puppies).
- **Gram-Scale Accuracy**: Eliminates the 18%–48% scoop error of measuring cups by converting kcal directly to grams and ounces.
- **Zero-Login Printable A4 PDF**: Generates clean fridge feeding charts with AM/PM meal checkboxes entirely client-side.

## Technical Guides & Veterinary References
- [PaceBowl Pet Nutrition Hub](https://pacebowl.com/): Overview of formulas, standard dog calorie table (10 lb to 100 lb), and FAQ
- [WSAVA Global Nutrition Guidelines](https://wsava.org/global-guidelines/global-nutrition-guidelines/): Veterinary clinical standard for Resting Energy Requirement (RER) and Daily Energy Requirement (DER)
- [Wikidata Dog Nutrition Entity](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q144): Canonical entity reference for domestic dogs (`Canis familiaris`)

## Reference Formulas
- Dog Neutered Adult DER = 1.6 * 70 * (kg^0.75)
- Cat Indoor Neutered DER = 1.2 * 70 * (kg^0.75)
- BARF Daily Grams = kg * 1000 * (body_weight_pct / 100)
